name: early_move_continuation
notes: Phase B's open question: does a move already well under way early in the session continue? A band name up >=10% from its open by 09:45-10:30, above VWAP, within 2% of its high of day, on real volume (>=30% of ADV already traded). Enter at the next bar's open, first match per session. No stop/target, to keep the first test free of tuned exit knobs.
